title: An Open Door
prompt: When Martin woke up that morning, he was surprised to see the door open. As soon as he crossed the threshold, he was beheaded.
solution: Martin was a canary who had lived in his cage for four months. Sylvester, a cat, had been waiting for a chance to catch him. When their owner accidentally left the cage door open, Martin flew out and Sylvester bit off his little head.
